questions.qAf: Die enigste intermolekulêre kragte tussen jodiummolekules (I₂) is …

questions.qAf: Die kelvintemperatuur van ’n vaste massa gas word by konstante druk verdubbel. Sy volume …

questions.q: The number of moles of solute in 200 cm³ of a 0,5 mol·dm⁻³ solution is …
questions.qAf: Die aantal mol opgeloste stof in 200 cm³ van ’n 0,5 mol·dm⁻³-oplossing is …

questions.q: For an endothermic reaction, …
questions.qAf: Vir ’n endotermiese reaksie …
options: energy is released to the surroundings.
the products have less energy than the reactants.
optionsAf: word energie aan die omgewing vrygestel.
het die produkte minder energie as die reaktanse.

questions.q: Define bond length.
questions.qAf: Definieer bindingslengte.
points: The average distance between the nuclei
pointsAf: Die gemiddelde afstand tussen die kerne

questions.q: State the relationship between bond energy and bond strength.
questions.qAf: Noem die verband tussen bindingsenergie en bindingsterkte.

questions.q: Write down the shape of each molecule: (a) CH₄, (b) BeCl₂, (c) BF₃, (d) H₂S.
questions.qAf: Skryf die vorm van elke molekuul neer: (a) CH₄, (b) BeCl₂, (c) BF₃, (d) H₂S.

questions.q: How many lone pairs are there on the central atom of H₂S?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel alleenpare is daar op die sentrale atoom van H₂S?

questions.q: How many lone pairs are there on the central atom of CH₄?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel alleenpare is daar op die sentrale atoom van CH₄?

questions.q: The electronegativities of H and O are 2,1 and 3,5. Calculate the electronegativity difference and classify the O–H bond.
questions.qAf: Die elektronegatiwiteite van H en O is 2,1 en 3,5. Bereken die elektronegatiwiteitsverskil en klassifiseer die O–H-binding.

questions.q: Explain why methane (CH₄) is a non-polar molecule.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom metaan (CH₄) ’n nie-polêre molekuul is.

sections.title: Intermolecular forces

questions.q: What are dipole-dipole forces?
questions.qAf: Wat is dipool-dipoolkragte?
points: Forces of attraction between polar molecules
the δ+ end of one molecule attracts the δ− end of another
pointsAf: die δ+-kant van een molekuul trek die δ−-kant van ’n ander aan

questions.q: Name the strongest type of intermolecular force in each compound.
questions.qAf: Noem die sterkste soort intermolekulêre krag in elke verbinding.

questions.q: Explain why HF has the highest boiling point, even though it has the smallest molar mass.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom HF die hoogste kookpunt het, al het dit die kleinste molêre massa.
points: HF has hydrogen bonds between its molecules
hydrogen bonds are much stronger than the dipole-dipole forces in HCl and HBr
so more energy is needed to overcome them
pointsAf: HF het waterstofbindings tussen sy molekules
waterstofbindings is baie sterker as die dipool-dipoolkragte in HCl en HBr
dus is meer energie nodig om hulle te oorkom

questions.q: Explain why HBr has a higher boiling point than HCl.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom HBr ’n hoër kookpunt as HCl het.
points: HBr molecules are larger, with more electrons
so the London forces between them are stronger
pointsAf: HBr-molekules is groter, met meer elektrone
dus is die Londonkragte tussen hulle sterker

questions.q: Identify the independent and the dependent variable in this comparison.
questions.qAf: Identifiseer die onafhanklike en die afhanklike veranderlike in hierdie vergelyking.
points: independent: the type of hydrogen halide

questions.q: Explain why ethanol dissolves completely in water.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom etanol volledig in water oplos.
points: Ethanol and water can both form hydrogen bonds
so ethanol molecules form hydrogen bonds with water molecules
pointsAf: Etanol en water kan albei waterstofbindings vorm
dus vorm etanolmolekules waterstofbindings met watermolekules

questions.q: State the relationship between the strength of intermolecular forces and boiling point.
questions.qAf: Noem die verband tussen die sterkte van intermolekulêre kragte en kookpunt.

sections.intro: The table shows the boiling points of three hydrogen halides.
sections.introAf: Die tabel toon die kookpunte van drie waterstofhaliede.

questions.q: State Charles’s law.
questions.qAf: Stel Charles se wet.
points: The volume of an enclosed gas is directly proportional to its kelvin temperature
pointsAf: Die volume van ’n ingeslote gas is direk eweredig aan sy kelvintemperatuur

questions.q: A gas occupies 4 dm³ at 150 kPa. Calculate its volume at 300 kPa if the temperature stays constant.
questions.qAf: ’n Gas beslaan 4 dm³ by 150 kPa. Bereken sy volume by 300 kPa as die temperatuur konstant bly.

questions.q: A gas occupies 2 dm³ at 17 °C. Calculate its volume at 77 °C at constant pressure.
questions.qAf: ’n Gas beslaan 2 dm³ by 17 °C. Bereken sy volume by 77 °C by konstante druk.

questions.q: Calculate the number of moles of gas in a 10 dm³ container at 150 kPa and 27 °C.
questions.qAf: Bereken die aantal mol gas in ’n houer van 10 dm³ by 150 kPa en 27 °C.

questions.q: State TWO assumptions of the kinetic theory about an ideal gas.
questions.qAf: Noem TWEE aannames van die kinetiese teorie oor ’n ideale gas.
points: The particles themselves have no volume
there are no forces between the particles (except during collisions)
pointsAf: Die deeltjies self het geen volume nie
daar is geen kragte tussen die deeltjies nie (behalwe tydens botsings)

questions.q: What is meant by absolute zero?
questions.qAf: Wat word bedoel met absolute nul?
points: at which the particles have the minimum possible kinetic energy
pointsAf: waarby die deeltjies die minimum moontlike kinetiese energie het

sections.title: Quantitative aspects: solutions and titrations

questions.q: What is a standard solution?
questions.qAf: Wat is ’n standaardoplossing?

questions.q: Calculate the mass of sodium hydroxide (NaOH) needed to make 500 cm³ of a 0,1 mol·dm⁻³ solution.
questions.qAf: Bereken die massa natriumhidroksied (NaOH) wat nodig is om 500 cm³ van ’n 0,1 mol·dm⁻³-oplossing te maak.

questions.scenario:
20 cm³ of a sulfuric acid solution is titrated with 0,2 mol·dm⁻³ sodium hydroxide. 25 cm³ of the base is needed to reach the endpoint.
H₂SO₄(aq) + 2NaOH(aq) → Na₂SO₄(aq) + 2H₂O(ℓ)
questions.scenarioAf:
20 cm³ van ’n swawelsuuroplossing word met 0,2 mol·dm⁻³-natriumhidroksied getitreer. 25 cm³ van die basis is nodig om die eindpunt te bereik.
H₂SO₄(aq) + 2NaOH(aq) → Na₂SO₄(aq) + 2H₂O(ℓ)

questions.q: Calculate the number of moles of NaOH used.
questions.qAf: Bereken die aantal mol NaOH wat gebruik is.

questions.q: Calculate the number of moles of H₂SO₄ that reacted.
questions.qAf: Bereken die aantal mol H₂SO₄ wat gereageer het.

questions.q: Calculate the concentration of the sulfuric acid.
questions.qAf: Bereken die konsentrasie van die swawelsuur.

questions.q: Name a suitable indicator for this titration and give a reason.
questions.qAf: Noem ’n geskikte indikator vir hierdie titrasie en gee ’n rede.
points: it is a strong acid–strong base titration, so the endpoint is at pH ≈ 7
pointsAf: dit is ’n sterk suur–sterk basis-titrasie, dus is die eindpunt by pH ≈ 7

questions.q: Name the apparatus used to measure out exactly 20 cm³ of the acid.
questions.qAf: Noem die apparaat wat gebruik word om presies 20 cm³ van die suur af te meet.

questions.q: Why is the flask swirled during the titration?
questions.qAf: Waarom word die fles tydens die titrasie geswaai?
points: so that the endpoint is seen accurately
pointsAf: Om die reaktanse deeglik te meng
sodat die eindpunt akkuraat waargeneem word

questions.scenario: Calcium carbonate reacts with excess hydrochloric acid: CaCO₃(s) + 2HCl(aq) → CaCl₂(aq) + H₂O(ℓ) + CO₂(g)
questions.scenarioAf: Kalsiumkarbonaat reageer met ’n oormaat soutsuur: CaCO₃(s) + 2HCl(aq) → CaCl₂(aq) + H₂O(ℓ) + CO₂(g)

questions.q: Calculate the volume of carbon dioxide, at STP, produced when 10 g of pure CaCO₃ reacts.
questions.qAf: Bereken die volume koolstofdioksied, by STD, wat gevorm word wanneer 10 g suiwer CaCO₃ reageer.

questions.q: A 12,5 g sample of impure CaCO₃ produces 0,1 mol of CO₂. Calculate the percentage purity of the sample.
questions.qAf: ’n Monster van 12,5 g onsuiwer CaCO₃ lewer 0,1 mol CO₂. Bereken die persentasie suiwerheid van die monster.

sections.introAf: Relatiewe atoommassas: H 1 ; C 12 ; O 16 ; Na 23 ; Cl 35,5 ; Ca 40 ; Zn 65. R = 8,31 J·K⁻¹·mol⁻¹. Molêre gasvolume by STD: 22,4 dm³·mol⁻¹.

questions.q: What is meant by the heat of reaction (ΔH)?
questions.qAf: Wat word bedoel met die reaksiewarmte (ΔH)?
points: The energy absorbed or released in a chemical reaction
pointsAf: Die energie wat in ’n chemiese reaksie geabsorbeer of vrygestel word

questions.scenario: The potential energy diagram below is for the reaction X + Y → Z. The energies are in kJ·mol⁻¹.
questions.scenarioAf: Die potensiële-energie-diagram hieronder is vir die reaksie X + Y → Z. Die energieë is in kJ·mol⁻¹.

questions.q: Calculate ΔH for the reaction.
questions.qAf: Bereken ΔH vir die reaksie.

questions.q: Calculate the activation energy for the forward reaction.
questions.qAf: Bereken die aktiveringsenergie vir die voorwaartse reaksie.

questions.q: Calculate the activation energy for the reverse reaction.
questions.qAf: Bereken die aktiveringsenergie vir die terugwaartse reaksie.

questions.q: Is the reaction exothermic or endothermic? Give a reason.
questions.qAf: Is die reaksie eksotermies of endotermies? Gee ’n rede.
points: the products have more potential energy than the reactants (ΔH > 0)
pointsAf: die produkte het meer potensiële energie as die reaktanse (ΔH > 0)

questions.q: How does a catalyst affect the activation energy and ΔH of this reaction?
questions.qAf: Hoe beïnvloed ’n katalisator die aktiveringsenergie en ΔH van hierdie reaksie?

questions.q: Explain, in terms of bond breaking and bond forming, why a reaction is exothermic.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik, in terme van die breek en vorm van bindings, waarom ’n reaksie eksotermies is.
points: The energy released when new bonds form in the products
is greater than the energy absorbed to break the bonds in the reactants
pointsAf: Die energie wat vrygestel word wanneer nuwe bindings in die produkte vorm
is groter as die energie wat geabsorbeer word om die bindings in die reaktanse te breek

questions.q: Give ONE everyday example of an exothermic process and ONE of an endothermic process.
questions.qAf: Gee EEN alledaagse voorbeeld van ’n eksotermiese proses en EEN van ’n endotermiese proses.
points: exothermic: burning wood or gas, or a hand warmer
endothermic: a cold pack dissolving, cooking an egg, or photosynthesis
pointsAf: eksotermies: brandende hout of gas, of ’n handverwarmer
endotermies: ’n koue pak wat oplos, ’n eier wat gaar word, of fotosintese

questions.q: Define an acid and a base according to the Arrhenius theory.
questions.qAf: Definieer ’n suur en ’n basis volgens die Arrhenius-teorie.

questions.scenario: The hydrogen carbonate ion reacts with water: HCO₃⁻(aq) + H₂O(ℓ) ⇌ H₂CO₃(aq) + OH⁻(aq)
questions.scenarioAf: Die waterstofkarbonaatioon reageer met water: HCO₃⁻(aq) + H₂O(ℓ) ⇌ H₂CO₃(aq) + OH⁻(aq)

questions.q: Identify the TWO conjugate acid-base pairs.
questions.qAf: Identifiseer die TWEE gekonjugeerde suur-basis-pare.

questions.q: Does HCO₃⁻ act as an acid or as a base in this reaction?
questions.qAf: Tree HCO₃⁻ as ’n suur of as ’n basis in hierdie reaksie op?
points: as a base (it accepts a proton)

questions.q: Write a balanced equation for a reaction in which HCO₃⁻ acts as an acid with water.
questions.qAf: Skryf ’n gebalanseerde vergelyking vir ’n reaksie waarin HCO₃⁻ as ’n suur met water optree.

questions.q: Give the term for a substance, such as HCO₃⁻, that can act as an acid or a base.
questions.qAf: Gee die term vir ’n stof, soos HCO₃⁻, wat as ’n suur of ’n basis kan optree.

questions.q: Explain why ethanoic acid is called a weak acid.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom etanoësuur ’n swak suur genoem word.
points: It ionises only partially in water
so only a small number of H₃O⁺ ions form
pointsAf: Dit ioniseer slegs gedeeltelik in water
dus vorm slegs ’n klein aantal H₃O⁺-ione

questions.q: Define a strong base.
questions.qAf: Definieer ’n sterk basis.
points: A base that dissociates completely in water
to form a high concentration of OH⁻ ions
pointsAf: ’n Basis wat volledig in water dissosieer
om ’n hoë konsentrasie OH⁻-ione te vorm

questions.q: Name ONE strong base.
questions.qAf: Noem EEN sterk basis.

questions.q: Write a balanced equation for the neutralisation of nitric acid by calcium hydroxide.
questions.qAf: Skryf ’n gebalanseerde vergelyking vir die neutralisasie van salpetersuur deur kalsiumhidroksied.

questions.q: Is a solution of ammonium chloride acidic, basic or neutral? Explain.
questions.qAf: Is ’n oplossing van ammoniumchloried suur, basies of neutraal? Verduidelik.
points: the ammonium ions react with water (hydrolysis) to form H₃O⁺ ions
pointsAf: die ammoniumione reageer met water (hidrolise) om H₃O⁺-ione te vorm

questions.q: Define reduction in terms of electron transfer.
questions.qAf: Definieer reduksie in terme van elektronoordrag.
points: by an atom or ion (its oxidation number decreases)
pointsAf: deur ’n atoom of ioon (sy oksidasiegetal neem af)

questions.q: Give the oxidation number of: (a) Mn in MnO₂, (b) S in SO₂, (c) Fe in Fe₂O₃.
questions.qAf: Gee die oksidasiegetal van: (a) Mn in MnO₂, (b) S in SO₂, (c) Fe in Fe₂O₃.

questions.scenario:
A strip of magnesium is placed in a silver nitrate solution:
Mg(s) + 2Ag⁺(aq) → Mg²⁺(aq) + 2Ag(s)
questions.scenarioAf:
’n Strook magnesium word in ’n silwernitraatoplossing geplaas:
Mg(s) + 2Ag⁺(aq) → Mg²⁺(aq) + 2Ag(s)

questions.q: Write down the oxidation half-reaction.
questions.qAf: Skryf die oksidasie-halfreaksie neer.

questions.q: Write down the reduction half-reaction.
questions.qAf: Skryf die reduksie-halfreaksie neer.

questions.q: Identify the reducing agent.
questions.qAf: Identifiseer die reduseermiddel.

questions.q: Give TWO observations that will be made.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE waarnemings wat gemaak sal word.
points: A grey or silvery layer of silver forms on the magnesium
pointsAf: ’n Grys of silwerige laag silwer vorm op die magnesium

questions.q: Give TWO ways to protect iron from rusting.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE maniere om yster teen roes te beskerm.
points: galvanising (coating with zinc), or attaching a more reactive metal
pointsAf: galvanisering (bedek met sink), of ’n meer reaktiewe metaal daaraan heg

sections.title: Limiting reagents

questions.q: What is meant by the excess reagent?
questions.qAf: Wat word bedoel met die oormaat-reagens?
points: The reactant that is not completely used up
so some of it is left over when the reaction stops
pointsAf: Die reaktans wat nie heeltemal opgebruik word nie
dus bly ’n deel daarvan oor wanneer die reaksie stop

questions.q: Calculate the number of moles of Zn.
questions.qAf: Bereken die aantal mol Zn.

questions.q: Calculate the number of moles of HCl.
questions.qAf: Bereken die aantal mol HCl.

questions.q: Determine which reactant is the limiting reagent. Show your working.
questions.qAf: Bepaal watter reaktans die beperkende reagens is. Toon jou bewerkings.
points: so HCl is the limiting reagent
pointsAf: dus is HCl die beperkende reagens

questions.q: Calculate the volume of hydrogen gas, at STP, that forms.
questions.qAf: Bereken die volume waterstofgas, by STD, wat vorm.

sections.intro: Zinc reacts with hydrochloric acid: Zn(s) + 2HCl(aq) → ZnCl₂(aq) + H₂(g). 13 g of zinc is added to 150 cm³ of 2 mol·dm⁻³ HCl.
sections.introAf: Sink reageer met soutsuur: Zn(s) + 2HCl(aq) → ZnCl₂(aq) + H₂(g). 13 g sink word by 150 cm³ 2 mol·dm⁻³-HCl gevoeg.
